name: join-three-table-chain
description: Benchmark three-table INNER and LEFT chains with prior aliases

queries.name: three-inner
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier, b.country FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id JOIN accounts b ON a.user_id = b.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: three-left
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier, b.country FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN accounts b ON a.user_id = b.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: three-cross-reference
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.country, b.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id JOIN accounts b ON b.user_id = e.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20
